visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and silver-rimmed glasses is sitting on a light beige leather sofa. She is wearing a navy and white striped cardigan over a beige knit top and dark leggings. She smiles and gestures with both hands as she speaks to the camera. Behind her is a modern interior with marble-textured walls and a clinic logo reading 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC'. A blue graphic box with the text '痘疤的治療與類型' is overlaid at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a high-definition close-up image of human skin showing a shallow, indented acne scar. On the top right, white text labels the scar type and lists several treatment options like 'TCA' and 'Dermal Grafting'. The woman is shown in a small inset at the bottom, pointing her finger toward the skin texture to highlight the scar. (3) The video cuts back to the woman on the sofa in a medium shot. She continues her explanation, using expressive facial movements and hand motions to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the professional studio environment. (4) Another close-up of skin is presented, this time showing 'Rolling Scars' which have a wave-like appearance. Text overlays appear on the right side listing specific laser and subcision treatments. The woman's head is visible at the bottom of the frame as she continues to narrate the visual evidence. (5) The woman returns to the main screen, sitting comfortably on the sofa. She maintains eye contact with the camera, looking friendly and authoritative. (6) A third skin close-up shows deep, narrow 'Icepick Scars'. White text on the right side identifies the type and suggests TCA and laser treatments. The background remains the close-up skin surface with visible pores. (7) Back to the woman on the sofa; she tilts her head slightly and gestures as she moves through the list of scar categories. (8) The final skin close-up demonstrates 'Boxcar Scars', characterized by sharp, square edges. Detailed treatment names like 'Erbium Laser' and 'Blue Peel' are listed in white text. (9) The woman is shown one last time on the sofa, posing with a hand under her chin in a thinking gesture before the scene fades. (10) A clean white screen appears featuring the clinic logo, contact information including a Line ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses in Taiwan (New Taipei and Taipei). The text 'contact us' is written in English and Chinese at the bottom.
